morphology.pattern_note: 外来人名，整词记忆；Elena 中的字母组合不是马来语词缀。规范书写首字母大写；不同语言中的元音和重音存在差异，未指定持有人读音时不填唯一 IPA。

senses.zh_definition: 埃莱娜：女性名字，在马来语文本中用作人名专有名词；中文译名可依本人惯用形式调整。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name used as a proper noun in Malay discourse.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi individu, lazimnya perempuan, yang ditulis Elena.
senses.nuances: 属于 kata nama khas。输入未提供 DBP 释义，本释义为编写说明，不是官方引文；status 标为 proper_name。不能把姓名的历史联想直接译成马来语普通词义。下列组合为用法示例，未经频次验证。姓名及多语言读音参见 [Behind the Name：Elena](https://www.behindthename.com/name/elena)。

etymology.historical_story: Elena is a form of Helen used in several European languages. The name family reaches back to Greek Helene and carries associations with classical mythology and Christian naming traditions. Its deeper etymology remains uncertain: proposed connections include a torch or the moon. These historical possibilities should not be presented as a settled literal meaning of Elena. Sources: [Elena](https://www.behindthename.com/name/elena), [Helen](https://www.behindthename.com/name/helen).
